description.narrative: Syftet är att stärka medborgerliga och politiska rättigheter i Moldavien. Projektets aktiviteter bidrar till de övergripande operativa mål: 1, att människor har möjlighet att hävda sina mänskliga rättigheter. 2, att stater tar ansvar för uppfyllandet av de mänskliga rättigheterna. 3, att stärka lokala människorättsförsvarare.

The aim is to strengthen civil and political rights in Moldova. The project activities contribute to the overall operative goals: 1, That people are empowered to claim their human rights. 2, That states take responsibility for the fulfillment of human rights. 3, That local human rights defenders are empowered.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2017Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: CRD’s Moldova programme funded by the Swedish Embassy and covered the period 2013-2016. The programme aimed at strengthening civil and political rights. The programme’s total budget was SEK 28 million over four years. Since 2013, CRD had an office in Moldova with two staff members. The evaluation of the programme in 2016 concludes that the programme implemented by CRD fits well with the broad priorities set out in the Results strategy for Sweden’s reform cooperation with Eastern Europe, the Western Balkans and Turkey 2014-2020. CRD has been able to identify relevant and effective partner organizations that in many ways have contributed effectively to the attainment of the programme objectives. The programme has been instrumental in strengthening the organizational development and results based management capacity, as well as the human rights related skills, of several partner organizations. Results have been particularly impressive when it comes to influencing the design of Moldova’s formal legal and institutional framework of relevance from a human rights perspective. Even though partner organization have also focused on monitoring implementation of the laws in force, shedding light on certain injustices and assisting aggrieved individuals whose rights are violated and occasionally mobilizing marginalized groups to stand up for their rights, the largely formal institution strengthening contributions of the partner organizations have not yet impacted significantly on the practical enjoyment of human rights.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
